title: Made a robot telenovela in 3 days for the Epic AI MegaJam. Fable 5.2 built most of it live inside Unreal through MCP
author: Novo88
selftext:
So this is my entry for the Epic AI MegaJam (theme was “Director’s Cut”). It’s called Lágrimas de Aceite. You’re the camera operator on a live robot soap opera, the director yells shot calls in your ear, you have to frame them before he cuts to your camera, and at the end you watch your episode as a broadcast with an audience rating. Robots crying oil, evil twins, a mom that faints, the usual.

The setup was Claude Code connected to Unreal 5.9 through the Unreal MCP, with me acting more like a director than a programmer (fitting for the theme lol). I used Fable 5.2 for pretty much the whole production side: the script, blocking the actors, animating, most of the coding, and building the environments too. The environments use assets from Fab, but Fable did the actual set dressing and placing. Opus 5.5 handled the rest.

Honestly the coolest part was watching the scenes get built in front of me. You ask for a living room set for a telenovela and you see the sofa, the lamps and the robots appearing in the editor one by one.

What I did by hand was mostly the creative calls: the story, the look (VHS post process), music, and a big list of camera and editing rules the agents had to follow. Stuff like “never cut to the same actor twice with similar shots”, or “the camera on the right should cover the actor on the left and vice versa”. That list made a huge difference, without it things got messy fast. Voices are ElevenLabs, made in one shot.

Not everything was smooth though. The voices didn’t ship in the first packaged build because the audio folders weren’t being cooked, and actors kept clipping through furniture until I made it a hard rule. Fitting it in under 1GB needed a few tweaks, but Claude knew what to cut from packaging and it just worked. It's the first time I've done this but I'm surprised by how fast I could get things done, especially with Fable (even though it eats through usage credits FAST).

If you want to give it a try, free on itch (Windows): [https://novo88.itch.io/a-robot-telenovela](https://novo88.itch.io/a-robot-telenovela)

comments.author: Electronic-Movie4208
comments.body: This is such a creative concept! 😂 A robot soap opera where you're the camera operator is hilarious. I love how you used AI to handle the technical side while focusing on directing. I'm building an RPG with AI myself, so it's cool seeing what's possible with Unreal and Claude. Great work!
